AllocatableQuota.description_en:
The user-allocatable quota amount. For general computing resources, each node has system-reserved resources. This value represents the quota resources that user workloads can occupy.

ActualMin = AllocatableQuota + SystemReservedQuota
AllocatableQuota.title: 用户可分配Quota量

description_en: Retrieves a list of resource quotas
description_zh: 您可以通过ListQuotas获取资源配额列表
kebab_example: aliyun paistudio list-quotas --quota-name quotajradxh43rgb --resource-type ECS --layout-mode Tree --parent-quota-id quotajradxh43rgb --quota-ids quota1ci8g793pgm,quotajradxh43rgb --workspace-ids 21345,38727 --statuses Creating --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --sort-by status --order desc --labels official=true,gpu=false --verbose true --workspace-name myshellprod --has-resource example-string --versions 1.0 --cluster-type RayCluster --gpu-type example-string --api-version 2022-01-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListQuotas

parameters.help_en: Filters by QuotaName. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 按照QuotaName过滤，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: quota_name

parameters.help_en: The resource type of the quota (Lingjun/ECS/ACS). Default value: ECS
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The display mode. Valid values: tree or list
parameters.help_zh: 展示方式，可以为树形或列表
parameters.name: layout_mode

parameters.help_en:
Filters by ParentQuotaId:

Not specified: lists all quotas under the tenant, including root quotas and child quotas.

Empty string: lists all root quotas.

Non-empty string: lists all child quotas of the specified ParentQuotaId
parameters.help_zh:
按ParentQuotaId过滤：

不传，列出租户下所有Quota，包含根Quota和子Quota。

传空，列出所有的根Quota。

传非空，列出指定ParentQuotaId的所有子Quota
parameters.name: parent_quota_id

parameters.help_en: Comma-separated QuotaIds for filtering. Only exact match is supported. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified at a time
parameters.help_zh: 逗号分隔，按QuotaIds过滤，只支持精确匹配，最多同时支持100个
parameters.name: quota_ids

parameters.help_en: Comma-separated WorkspaceIds for filtering. Only exact match is supported. A maximum of 10 IDs can be specified at a time
parameters.help_zh: 逗号分隔，按WorkspaceIds过滤，只支持精确匹配，最多同时支持10个
parameters.name: workspace_ids

parameters.help_en: Comma-separated quota statuses for filtering. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 逗号分隔按照Quota Statuses过滤，只支持精确匹配
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询第几页数据，最小值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询的分页大小，最小值为1
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:

GmtModifiedTime
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: desc or asc
